source_claims: After three external orthogonal directions, further external orthogonal unfolding is exhausted.
Frustration is necessity of continuation plus impossibility of completion by the previous method.
P4 is not a fourth spatial dimension.

formalization.continuation_set: D_ext(P) = {d | d is an admissible external orthogonal continuation under the current regime}

working_hypotheses: r_ext(P0)=3, r_ext(P1)=2, r_ext(P2)=1, r_ext(P3)=0 if D_ext receives vector-space structure.
not_established: P4 is a fourth independent spatial direction.
J is an ordinary linear reflection.
The exhaustion transition is a Clifford generator.
